moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-sub:
Subject of the re-engagement email.

Parameters:
* $1 - the total number of views of the articles that the user edited
* $2 - the username of the recipient, for GENDER
moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-tot:
Text below the large number at the top of the re-engagement email.

Parameters:
* $1 - the total number of views, shown above this text. Use it only for PLURAL.
* $2 - the username of the recipient, for GENDER
moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-int:
First sentence of the re-engagement email. It also shows in the inbox, after the subject.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username of the recipient. Also use it for GENDER.
* $2 - the number of editors this month (225,000)
moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-cta: Heading of the box in the re-engagement email that asks the user to edit again.

Text in the box in the re-engagement email that asks the user to edit again. "Suggested edits" is the name of a feature of the newcomer homepage.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username of the recipient, for GENDER

Label of the button in the re-engagement email. The button opens the newcomer homepage ([[Special:Homepage]]).

Parameters:
* $1 - the username of the recipient, for GENDER. English does not use it.
moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-pag:
Heading above the list of up to three articles that the user edited, in the re-engagement email.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username of the recipient, for GENDER

Number of views of one article since the user edited it, in the re-engagement email.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of views

Link text to the latest change of an article, in the re-engagement email. Used as $1 in {{msg-mw|moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-page-new-edits-by}}.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of edits to the article since the user edited it

Line about the activity on an article since the user edited it, in the re-engagement email.

Parameters:
* $1 - a link with the text {{msg-mw|moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-page-new-edits}}. In the plain-text email, only the link text; the URL follows the sentence.
* $2 - the number of other people who edited the article
moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-foo:
Footer of the re-engagement email.

Parameters:
* $1 - a link to the user's notification preferences, with the text {{msg-mw|moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-footer-preferences}}. In the plain-text email, only the link text; the URL follows the sentence.
* $2 - the username of the recipient, for GENDER

Link text in {{msg-mw|moderator-toolkit-reengagement-email-footer}}. The link opens the notification preferences.
{{Identical|Preferences}}
